title: Revisit examples/aoc25 slow parts with better algorithms and the new features
description: After the runtime fixes (eu-oaz72.34, .4, .27, the foldr sharing and range bugs) and dict (.21), re-measure all 2025 parts and update examples/aoc25 and PERFORMANCE.md. Algorithmic rewrites identified: d04 p2 worklist peel with a dict of neighbour counts (~80k O(log n) ops, ~1-2 s) instead of full rescans; d09 p2 coordinate compression to a ~248x248 grid with 2D prefix sums, O(1) per red pair (expressible today with vec/arr); d10 p1 bitmask BFS with bit.xor/bit.popcount (~1M ops); d10 p2 vec.of for rows/pivots/frees and better pruning (LP-relaxation bounds) for machines with 3 free variables; d08 dist2 with destructured arithmetic instead of zip-with/map/sum; d11 p2 dict assoc instead of merge(table, kv-block) per node; d05 dict range lookup. Note par-* forks by default; report sequential and parallel.
acceptance_criteria: Every 2025 part finishes; PERFORMANCE.md re-baselined with protocol labels; solutions remain idiomatic per docs/eucalypt-style.md.

comments.author: Claude
comments.text: Plan (lane: days 10-12, branch eu-oaz72.38/aoc25-days-10-12). Day 10: replace float RREF/Bareiss branch-and-bound with one subset table per machine (every button subset grouped by parity bitmask, bit.xor/bit.shl); part 1 = smallest subset matching the lights; part 2 = parity halving (x = s + 2y) walked level by level with a dict keyed by remaining target vector. Day 11: graph as dict, self-referential lazy dict memo, forbidden-node sets, par-map over the four inclusion-exclusion terms. Day 12: shapes reduced to cell counts at parse, cons destructuring. Verify answers against old solutions (day 10 p2 per machine), measured-single medians of 3. No engine/prelude change needed. PERFORMANCE.md untouched (#1273).
